mechanism.claim: The U.S. Treasury Office of Financial Research publishes a daily market-based global Financial Stress Index built from 33 variables spanning credit, equity valuation, funding, safe assets and volatility. An unusually large completed daily stress change is a broad systemic risk repricing; during elevated completed BTC variation, rising stress maps short BTC and falling stress maps long BTC for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the completed OFR FSI observation-to-observation change

external_support.reported_definition: daily market-based snapshot constructed from 33 variables; positive levels denote above-average stress
external_support.official_latency: published data are current from two business days prior
external_support.inference_disclosure: change-tail event, BTC variation gate, directional map and 24-hour hold are preregistered adaptations

mechanism.why_distinct: HVNFCI uses weekly Chicago Fed real-time-vintage financial conditions and a 72-hour weekend clock. HVOFSR uses the Treasury OFR daily global stress composite, its official two-business-day delay, a daily change shock and a 24-hour clock. Existing Cboe, Treasury-yield, dollar, equity and crypto candidates use narrower objects.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both the systemic-stress change and completed BTC variation must lie in causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a delayed federal daily systemic-stress release clock is absent from Gross9

features.observation: finite total OFR FSI value on source observation date D
features.change: FSI[D]-FSI[immediately previous exact source row], strict nonzero
features.stress_change_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(change) over at most 252 valid changes, minimum 126, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.availability: 22:00 UTC on the date of the second subsequent exact OFR source row, conservatively after the official two-business-day publication lag and US cash close
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTCUSDT 1m log(close/open)) over 24 elapsed hours ending at availability
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.missing_revision_or_duplicate: duplicate date, schema drift, nonfinite value, missing BTC minute or nonmonotone dates reject; no imputation

clock.decision: 22:00 UTC on second subsequent OFR source-row date
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

ofr.provider: U.S. Treasury Office of Financial Research

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent official daily systemic-stress object with stated causal publication lag

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source contract and byte reproduction, source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90; no source, latency, threshold, side, hold, clock, subset or control repair
